issue.title: [orchagent] Missing backslash continuation in docker-init.j2 skips wait_for_link.sh rendering

failure.body:
### Description

`dockers/docker-orchagent/docker-init.j2` line 24 is missing the trailing `\` continuation character in the multi-line `sonic-cfggen` invocation. This causes line 25 (`-t .../wait_for_link.sh.j2,...`) to be treated as a separate command rather than part of the `sonic-cfggen` call.

### Current code
```bash
    -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/supervisord.conf.j2,/etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf
    -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/wait_for_link.sh.j2,/usr/bin/wait_for_link.sh \
```
Line 24 (supervisord.conf.j2) is missing the trailing `\`.

### Impact
The `wait_for_link.sh` template is never rendered by `sonic-cfggen`, meaning the script at `/usr/bin/wait_for_link.sh` may be empty or stale.

### Fix
Add `\` at the end of line 24.

resolution.title: [agent][orchagent] Fix missing backslash continuation in docker-init.j2
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Add missing trailing `\` on the supervisord.conf.j2 line in the docker-orchagent docker-init.j2 template.

#### How I did it
Added `\` at the end of line 24 so the `wait_for_link.sh.j2` template argument is included in the `sonic-cfggen` invocation.

#### How to verify it
Inspect the generated docker-init.sh inside docker-orchagent — `wait_for_link.sh` should now be rendered from its template.

#### Which release branch to backport
master

#### Description for the changelog
Fix missing backslash in orchagent docker-init.j2 that prevented wait_for_link.sh template rendering.

Fixes: #26402
